We have tools: get_zipcode_based_on_city, estimate_distance already used, estimate_drive_feasibility_by_mileage, get_outside_temperature_from_google, get_outside_temperature_from_weather_com, get_current_speed, etc. We also have displayCarStatus, display_log, etc.

Then we can estimate drive feasibility by mileage using estimate_drive_feasibility_by_mileage with distance 750. Also maybe get outside temperature? Not necessary. But we might want to get outside temperature to consider fuel consumption? Not required.

So step: call displayCarStatus with option "fuel" to see current fuel. Then call estimate_drive_feasibility_by_mileage with distance 750.
